context.title: Makroprudenzielle Instrumente
context.description: Die lernende Person kann makroprudenzielle Instrumente (z. B. antizyklischer Kapitalpuffer) erklären und einordnen.
context.descriptionEn: The learner can explain and classify macroprudential instruments, such as the countercyclical capital buffer.

originalReason: Four bank motifs on each side illustrate network expansion and stress. Non-denominated shield-marked buffer units depict conditional build-up and release, not new foreign reserves or donated cash. The regulatory buffer requirement and loss-absorbing-capital meaning need the accompanying goal case; no quantitative level or automatic cycle forecast is claimed.
